request.prompt:
Create one isolated, full-body game-character production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, using the attached original game reference as the visual authority. Faithfully reproduce the specific original model, its anatomy, proportions, materials, color blocking, equipment placement and asymmetry. Detailed realistic game-render finish, crisp readable silhouette, even studio lighting with subtle material highlights. Output exactly ONE character and ONE view, with the complete head, body, every limb, weapon and feet inside the image and generous transparent padding on all sides. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no scene, no frame, no contact sheet, no text, no captions, no publisher logos. The attached sheet is a reference for the single figure, not a layout to reproduce. Preserve model-side asymmetry; do not mirror the reference. Do not add equipment, insignia, effects or redesigned parts. This is a still pose, not an animation sheet.

Subject: Admiral Steven Hackett, specifically his Mass Effect 3 model in the attached original Kolby Jukes game-model sheet. A mature male Alliance admiral with the exact face proportions, weathered cheek details, blue eyes, short gray hair, narrow gray moustache and pointed goatee shown. Navy blue service cap with short black visor, fine gold piping and the original small Alliance badge. Dark navy dress uniform, broad rigid gold-striped epaulettes with the narrow maroon outer accent, gold piping along the asymmetrical jacket closure, small chest medals and insignia, short gold chain at the chest, gold sleeve and cuff rank bands, matching blue trousers, simple polished black shoes. Preserve the straight dignified body proportions and the blue fabric/black lower jacket material separation. Use a three-quarter standing view facing image-right, informed by the second view from the left, with the same pale gray rifle held low across the body in both hands. Keep his recognizable older facial identity, uniform tailoring and reference-side insignia placement; do not change him into a generic soldier or add armor. This is a visual reference for a supporting narrative character, not a claim that he is a playable fighter. Both entire shoes and the full cap must have transparent clearance.
